lessonRef.focus: the place-value structure of three-digit numbers
lessonRef.title: Concept build A: the place-value structure of three-digit numbers

sections.title: Learn: Find the Nearby Hundreds
sections.directions: Today you will learn how to round a number to the nearest hundred. Rounding finds a nearby hundred that is easier to use. First, find the two hundreds around the number. For 327, the nearby hundreds are 300 and 400. Picture a number line: 300 — 327 — 400.

sections.title: Learn: Let the Tens Digit Help
sections.directions: The tens digit tells which hundred is nearer. A tens digit from 0 through 4 means the number is closer to the lower hundred. A tens digit from 5 through 9 means the number is halfway or closer to the higher hundred. The ones digit does not make this choice.

sections.title: Learn: What Happens Halfway?
sections.directions: A number ending in 50 is exactly halfway between two hundreds. It is the same distance from both. Our rounding rule says to choose the higher hundred when the tens digit is 5. So halfway numbers round up.

sections.title: Examples
sections.directions: Read each example. Notice the nearby hundreds, the tens digit, and why the answer is nearer.

items.prompt: Example 1 — Round 243 to the nearest hundred.

steps: Step 3: 4 is less than 5, so choose 200.
Why: 243 is 43 away from 200 and 57 away from 300. It is closer to 200.

items.prompt: Example 2 — Round 678 to the nearest hundred.

steps: Step 3: 7 is 5 or more, so choose 700.
Why: 678 is 78 away from 600 and only 22 away from 700. It is closer to 700.

items.prompt: Example 3 — Round 550 to the nearest hundred.

steps: Step 3: A 5 means the number is halfway, so choose the higher hundred, 600.
Why: 550 is 50 away from both hundreds. When a number is halfway, we round up.

sections.title: Let's Try One
sections.directions: Work with your teaching adult. The clues get smaller as you go.

sections.title: Need Help?
sections.directions: Remember: find the two hundreds around the number. Then look at the tens digit. 0–4 means choose the lower hundred. 5–9 means choose the higher hundred.

items.prompt: 371 is between which two hundreds?
Look at 526. Which digit helps you round to the nearest hundred?
487 is between 400 and 500. Should you round down or up?
Now put the steps together. Round 438 to the nearest hundred.
items.responseExpectation: Write your answer. Show or tell how you know.
